items.title: Wardel Quezergue Interview, 1995-10-25
items.q: Of course, Mr. Curl. You know, if I never understood, some things I never understood, I would ask him and he would be very kind to take the time to explain what it was.

ctx.x: Okay, just for the record, I just want to get your birthday and where you were born.

I was born in 1930 in New Orleans, Louisiana. My family is a musical, have a musical background. My father played banjo and guitar. He did a couple of, before I was born, he did a couple of things with Louis Armstrong, so he claims. I have a brother that plays drum. He plays with the Dixieland groups in town. His name is Leo. I have an older brother named Sid. He plays trumpet. He does a lot of little jobs in ballrooms and MCs and all that kind of stuff. And I had uncles that played, one played piano, had some…
What did you play? I played trumpet. Okay. You know.
